trigger.description: Proportional budget shrink hit a section floor: under a tight --tokens budget the quota mix could not honor every section share, so lower-priority items were evicted to keep the floor order rules > warnings > decisions > loadBearing (rules never drop to zero while any exist; ADR 0065 §2/§6). meta.floors_engaged names the sections.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Always run the verify script before pushing changes to the main branch of this repository, without exception, every single time.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule --json

notes: The floor is the contract working: a 200-token primer is a selection subset of the 600-token primer, not a rewrite (golden-tested at 200/600/4000 in tests/primer_cli_golden.rs). Agents seeing this code with an unexpectedly thin primer should raise --tokens rather than treat the output as incomplete.
